title: Cold-formed steel construction.
officialText:
Special inspections for prefabricated and site built cold-formed steel light-frame
construction and assemblies shall be as required by this section and Table 1704.3.4. The special inspector shall verify the size,
quality, framing, erection, and both temporary and permanent bracing.
TABLE 1704.3.4
REQUIRED VERIFICATION AND INSPECTION OF
COLD-FORMED STEEL LIGHT-FRAME CONSTRUCTION
Verification and inspection Continuous Periodic Referenced Code
Standard Reference
1. Material Verification:
a. Verify that identification markings conform to AISI
AISI 200,
S200 and as specified in the approved construction X
Section A5.4
documents.
b. Verify that material is clean, straight and undamaged. X
2. Inspection of general framing:
a. Verify that member sizes conform to the approved
X
construction documents.
b. Verify that member layout conforms to the approved
X
construction documents.
c. Verify that proper bearing lengths are provided in
X
accordance with approved construction documents.
d. Verify that punched holes and sheared or flame cut
edges of material in members are clean and free from X
notches and burred edges.
3. Inspection of framing connections and anchorages:
a. Verify that screws, bolts, and other fasteners conform
to approved construction document requirements for AISI S200,
X
diameter, length, quantity, spacing, edge distance, and Section D
location.
b. Verify that manufactured connectors, such as joist
hangers, caps, straps, clips, ties, hold-downs, and
AISI S200,
anchors conform to approved construction document X
Section D
requirements for manufacturer, type, gauge, and
fastener requirements.
4. Inspection of welding:
a. Inspect welds in accordance with Table 1704.3. X AWS D1.3
5. Bracing:
a. Verify that temporary bracing, shoring, jacks, etc., are
installed, and not removed until no longer necessary,
X
in accordance with the approved construction
documents and approved erection drawings.
b. Verify that permanent bracing, web stiffeners,
bridging, blocking, wind bracing, etc, are installed in
X
accordance with the approved construction documents
and approved erection drawings.
c. Where a cold-formed steel truss clear span is 60 feet
(18 288 mm) or greater, the special inspector shall
verify that the temporary installation restraint/bracing
X 2210.3.4
and the permanent individual truss member
restraint/bracing are installed in accordance with the
approved truss submittal package.
